Perhaps the user is interested in a different formula for calculating the area of a triangle based on its vertices. If you know the coordinates of the vertices of the triangle, you can use the shoelace formula to find the area of the triangle. The formula is

`Area = ½ | (x1 × y2 + x2 × y3 + x3 × y1) - (x2 × y1 + x3 × y2 + x1 × y3) |`

where `x1`, `x2`, `x3` are the x-coordinate of the vertices of the triangle and `y1`, `y2`, `y3` are the y-coordinate of the vertices of the triangle.

Notice tha `function.area()` is making some assumptions about the relationship of the points that make up triangle `XYZ`.
